name: Michal
whenBasis: In the reigns of Saul and David, dated by counting back from Solomon; 1 Samuel 13:1, which gives Saul's age and years, is damaged in the Hebrew.
summary: Saul's younger daughter, who loved David; Saul gave her to him for a hundred Philistine foreskins, hoping he would be killed. She let David down through a window when Saul's men came for him and put a household idol in his bed. Saul then gave her to another man; David demanded her back as king. When she saw him leaping and dancing before the ark, she despised him, and she had no children to the day of her death.
body: She is the only woman in the Bible said to love a man. Her quick action saves David's life, and she tells her father's messengers he is sick.

Given to Paltiel son of Laish, she is taken back to David by Abner's arrangement, Paltiel following behind weeping as far as Bahurim. On the day the ark comes to Jerusalem, she watches from a window and meets David with scorn: “How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today!” He answers that the LORD chose him over her father.
